prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in personal injuries to our client. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further demand that your company, your insured, and all agents acting on their behalf preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and all related correspondence. Any destruction or alteration of such material could seriously prejudice our client's claim.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
